third: Diego builds his own grill, and you two have a cook-off in the next town.
lines: diego_tinker
Listen, listen, if I put a little spring bellows under your grill, my friend, the coals stay perfect all night without you touching them!
sebastian_bloodmage
Without touching them? Che, the touching is the whole point, the fire tells you things with your hands in it.
diego_tinker
Sure, sure, and my bellows tells you things without burning your hair off. Your eyebrows are half gone, look at them.

third: In the next town, you each teach the other one your game, and then you never mention it again.
lines: sebastian_bloodmage
Football, che, is the only sport where a whole country cries on the same day. Name me another one.
diego_tinker
Baseball, my friend! In Maracaibo the whole street stops for the Aguilas, the whole street, even the dogs.
sebastian_bloodmage
Baseball is a picnic where somebody occasionally runs, boludo. My grandmother could play it in her slippers.

third: Sebastian does the meat, Yiannis does everything else, and you both sit down to eat it.
lines: yiannis_paladin
Tonight I cook, my friend, a proper Cretan supper, slow, with oil and lemon and patience.
sebastian_bloodmage
Patience is for people who aren't hungry, che. I've already got the fire going and the meat salted.
yiannis_paladin
You salted it already? Panagia mou, without asking the old man, at his own fire on his own beach?

third: Whoever loses an arm wrestle has to sit through the other one's game and cheer.
lines: sebastian_bloodmage
Football is art, che, twenty two people and one ball and the whole world holding its breath.
rhodri_knight
Football's twenty two lads falling over when the wind blows, butt. Rugby's where you find out who you are.
sebastian_bloodmage
Rugby is a fight in the mud that somebody decided to write rules for afterwards, boludo.

third: Diego rigs it, Rhodri checks it, and nobody at all stands in front of that door.
lines: diego_tinker
She's ready, my friends, the charge is on the hinge, everybody step back and I light it, yes?
rhodri_knight
No, hang on, mun, you haven't checked the wire, I watched you twist it with your teeth.
diego_tinker
My teeth are very precise, my friend, they've done more wiring than your whole crew put together!

third: A small fire out here tonight, and the biggest fire in the next town, I promise.
lines: sebastian_bloodmage
More wood, chicos, more wood! A big fire, a proper one, so the meat cooks right and the cold stays out.
sondre_stormbringer
The wind is going to back round before midnight, and a big fire in a backing wind is how you lose a camp.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, the fire and I have an understanding, we've been friends since before you were born.

sides.diego_tinker: one little spark for the machine

third: Try it once, in open ground, with everybody standing well back and Sondre calling it.
lines: diego_tinker
Just one spark, my friend, one tiny little lightning into this coil, and she runs for a week!
sondre_stormbringer
No, I am sorry, there is no such thing as one tiny lightning. You are standing right next to the coil.
diego_tinker
So I stand a bit further away! Come on, you're always so careful, it's a coil, not a barn.
sondre_stormbringer
Please do not say that word to me, not about this.

third: Rhodri holds the front, Sondre goes wide on the flank where there's nobody to hit.
lines: rhodri_knight
I'm stood in front, butt, that's where I go, that's what I'm for, end of discussion.
sondre_stormbringer
If you stand in front, you stand where my storm lands, and I will have to hold it back for you.
rhodri_knight
Then hold it back, mun, I'm not moving, I've had bigger things than weather land on me.

sides.diego_tinker: put a motor on the boat

third: Diego builds a motor, Yiannis keeps the oars, and the boat gets both.
lines: diego_tinker
Your boat, my friend, imagine it with a little clockwork motor, you'd be at the reef before breakfast!
yiannis_paladin
Before breakfast, you say? Re, the whole point of the morning is the rowing, slow, with the sea waking up around you.
diego_tinker
The sea can wake up faster, it won't mind, I'll make the motor quiet, almost quiet.

third: Tomorrow morning, one boat: Sondre sails it and Yiannis fishes from it.
lines: sondre_stormbringer
With respect, you only know the top of the water from a fishing boat. Sailing, you have to read all of it.
yiannis_paladin
Only the top of it? Little one, I have been under that water since I was nine, holding my breath for octopus.
sondre_stormbringer
Under it, yes, but a sailor has to argue with the wind as well, and the wind always argues back.

third: A duet, and whoever forgets the words first does the washing up.
lines: rhodri_knight
Right, song time, boys, and tonight it's Calon Lan, proper, in four parts if you lot can manage two.
yiannis_paladin
Ela, every night the Welsh hymns, my friend. Tonight a mantinada, and I will make one about your beard.
rhodri_knight
My beard is a national treasure, butt, you leave it out of your poetry.

sides.ryan_warlock: a whiskey, neat, after a day like that

third: You each pour the other a glass of yours, and judge it honestly, on the record.
lines: ryan_warlock
A man finishes a day like that with a whiskey, Esteban, neat, no ice, and no lecture about my liver.
esteban_bloodmage
I'd never lecture you, Ryan. I'd simply note that a carmenere does the same work, with considerably less damage to the stomach lining.
ryan_warlock
The stomach lining, he says. That's the most Chilean way anyone's ever told me to drink wine.

sides.sondre_stormbringer: boil it in the pot with the grounds, like home

third: Leif makes it his way at dawn, Sondre makes it his way at dusk, and nobody says a word about either.
lines: sondre_stormbringer
Leif, I think perhaps you are making the coffee wrong. In Norway we boil it in the pot, with the grounds, and let them sink.
leif_primalist
Yep, my grandfather did that. Tasted like the bottom of a stump every single morning of my childhood.
sondre_stormbringer
That is the correct taste. Uff, I cannot believe a Halvorsen is saying this to me.

sides.marcus_stormbringer: trust three weeks of pressure readings
sides.sondre_stormbringer: trust the gulls and the water

third: Marcus keeps his notes, Sondre keeps watch on the beach, and whoever's right gets the first hot drink.
lines: marcus_stormbringer
Sondre, I've got three weeks of pressure readings that say the front comes in tonight, not tomorrow. Three whole weeks of them!
sondre_stormbringer
And I have the gulls, Marcus. They are sitting on the beach, quite calm. A gull does not care about your three weeks.
marcus_stormbringer
You're telling me a seabird is out-forecasting me. Sorry, no, I'm not accepting that, not from a gull.

sides.diego_tinker: put a spring in the lock that pinches whoever picks it
sides.marco_paladin: a lock should be simple and honest

third: Diego builds his clever lock for the cart, and Marco keeps the inn door simple.
lines: diego_tinker
Marco, my friend, listen, listen, what if your lock had a little spring that pinches the fingers of whoever tries to pick it?
marco_paladin
A lock keeps a door shut, ragazzo. It doesn't bite. Thirty-one years, and none of mine ever bit anyone.
diego_tinker
Sure, sure, and none of yours ever played a little song when it opened either. Think about it, a song, Marco!

sides.yiannis_paladin: light a candle for Saint Nicholas before setting out
sides.ryan_warlock: luck's a deal, and saints don't sign anything

third: Ryan lights the candle himself, and calls it a gesture of goodwill to the other party.
lines: yiannis_paladin
Ela, Ryan, light a candle with me for Saint Nicholas before we go. He watches over everyone on the water, even brokers.
ryan_warlock
With respect, Yiannis, I've never met a saint who'd sign anything. I'll take my chances with a contract.
yiannis_paladin
A candle is a contract, my boy, the oldest one there is. You give a little light, and he gives you back the shore.

sides.marcus_stormbringer: camp on the ridge, where the sky's in full view
sides.leif_primalist: camp in the hollow, away from that dead snag

third: Camp in the hollow, and Marcus takes the first watch up on the ridge with his notes.
lines: marcus_stormbringer
The ridge is perfect, Leif, I can see the weather coming for miles, and we'd get a full hour's warning on anything.
leif_primalist
There's a dead snag right over it, leaning at the tents. That wind you're so excited about brings it down at three in the morning.
marcus_stormbringer
So we pitch ten feet to the left of it! I've done the maths, the lean takes it the other way, I'm almost certain.

sides.esteban_bloodmage: ask before you take a single drop, every time
sides.sebastian_bloodmage: it's an ingredient, use what's there

third: Sebastian asks before he cooks with it, and Esteban stays for dinner.
lines: sebastian_bloodmage
Che, Esteban, a little blood off the boar and a little off the boys, it's all the same in the pan, the fire doesn't ask questions!
esteban_bloodmage
The fire may not, Sebastian. I do, every time, and I'd ask you to start before somebody objects after the fact.
sebastian_bloodmage
After the fact they're eating, boludo, and nobody objects with a full plate. Ask anyone at my table.

sides.ivan_warrior: tea is black, strong, and it stews for as long as it needs
sides.dan_warrior: builder's tea, milk in, bag out, done in two minutes

third: Two pots, one black and one milky, and they both drink from the wrong one by accident.
lines: ivan_warrior
Dan, you're pouring milk into tea that's been in the water for ninety seconds. In Novosibirsk this would be a police matter.
dan_warrior
It's a brew, lad, not a ceremony. Bag in, bag out, splash of milk, and you're back on the floor before the foreman notices.
ivan_warrior
Tea should be so dark you can't see the bottom of the glass, my friend. Yours looks like the water from washing a tram.

sides.ryan_warlock: agree the split in writing before anybody opens the chest
sides.silas_rogue: flip for it, it's faster and nobody can argue with a coin

third: Ryan writes it down, and Silas flips the coin to decide who signs first.
lines: ryan_warlock
Silas, before anyone touches that chest, let's put the split on paper. Shares, terms, signatures, and it takes five minutes.
silas_rogue
Five minutes is a long time with a chest that size, mate. I flip, heads it's yours, tails it's mine, and we all go home happy.
ryan_warlock
I've watched you flip that coin for a week, and it lands tails a suspicious amount. I'd like that clause in writing too.

sides.berat_tinker: talk them through it, a scared patient bleeds faster
sides.esteban_bloodmage: work fast and quiet, the talking can come after

third: Esteban works and Berat talks, and the patient says it's the best care they've ever had.
lines: berat_tinker
Esteban, canim, you can't just put your hands on a frightened man and start. Tell him what you're doing first, the fear makes everything worse.
esteban_bloodmage
With the bleeding he had, Berat, every sentence costs him a little more. I'd rather he lived to complain about my manners.
berat_tinker
Aman, thirty years of frightened people in my chair, and the ones I talked to never bit me once. Give me the first minute, that's all.

sides.dan_warrior: the big lad takes the front, that's what he's for
sides.marco_paladin: the front belongs to whoever has the Light to hold it

third: They take the front together, shoulder to shoulder, and argue about it the whole fight.
lines: dan_warrior
Marco, love, I'm stood at the front, and that's where I'm staying. You go and do your glowing from behind me.
marco_paladin
Thirty-one years I've stood at a door, Dan, and I'll stand at this one. The Light holds better than a shield, ragazzo.
dan_warrior
Your Light's very nice, but my shield's the one getting hit. Sod it, there's room for two, budge up then.

sides.ivan_warrior: we leave at first light, which means first light
sides.diego_tinker: we leave when the thing I'm building is finished

third: Ivan gives Diego ten minutes, and Diego builds a clock in eleven.
lines: ivan_warrior
Diego, the sun came up twenty minutes ago. In my world, twenty minutes late is a disciplinary hearing, and here it's breakfast.
diego_tinker
Listen, listen, Ivan, ten more minutes and this thing tells us exactly when the sun comes up. We'll never be late again!
ivan_warrior
I already know when the sun comes up, my friend, I watched it happen. It happened without you, and it was very rude.

sides.berat_tinker: a guest never cooks, it's an insult to the house
sides.sebastian_bloodmage: the man with the fire and the meat feeds the table

third: Sebastian cooks the meat, Berat makes everything else, and the table can't move after.
lines: berat_tinker
Sebastian, sit, sit, you're my guest tonight. In Izmir, a guest who cooks is a guest who's been insulted.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, Berat, in Buenos Aires the man with the fire feeds the people, and look, I have the fire. Sit down yourself!
berat_tinker
Mashallah, so stubborn, you'd fight a grandmother for the kitchen. Fine, you take the meat, and I'll feed everyone else until they cry.

sides.haruto_runemaster: cut the rune properly, however long it takes
sides.diego_tinker: a quick fix now beats a perfect one tomorrow

third: Diego builds his quick fix, and Haruto cuts the proper rune under it while it holds.
lines: haruto_runemaster
Diego, that gadget will fail the first time anyone leans on it. A rune cut properly would hold for a hundred years.
diego_tinker
Listen, listen, Haruto, a hundred years is lovely, but the wolves are coming tonight! Mine works in ten minutes.
haruto_runemaster
Then it will fail in eleven, on whoever is standing closest. Careless work always picks the wrong person.

sides.minh_chronomancer: a proper watch rota, written down, everyone takes a turn
sides.dan_warrior: the big lad takes first watch and the rest sleep

third: Minh writes the rota, and Dan takes first watch on it, officially.
lines: minh_chronomancer
Dan, I have drawn up a watch rota, four shifts, rotating. You are on third, and I would like you to sleep until then.
dan_warrior
Give over, love, I'll take first and second, I'm awake anyway. You need your kip more than I do.
minh_chronomancer
That is precisely what I tell myself every night, and look where it got me. Third shift, Dan, please, and I will try to sleep too.

sides.tomas_warrior: retie the tent ropes with proper knots before the storm
sides.bakyt_hunter: six generations of felt tents never needed new knots

third: Tomas reties two ropes his way, Bakyt leaves the rest his way, and they compare in the morning.
lines: tomas_warrior
Bakyt, mate, those tent ropes are tied with a knot I've never seen, and I've seen every knot there is. Let me retie them before the wind.
bakyt_hunter
My grandfather's grandfather tied this knot, friend, on the high pasture in worse wind than this. Drink your tea, it will hold.
tomas_warrior
Your grandfather's grandfather didn't have my shoulder telling him a storm's coming. Two ropes, my way, and we see who's dry tomorrow.

sides.matias_reaper: the quiet one at the back is the thief
sides.silas_rogue: the loud one at the counter is the thief

third: They watch both, and it turns out the two traders are working together.
lines: matias_reaper
Silas, the thief is the quiet one by the door, I am sure. On the bus, the quiet ones by the door were always the problem.
silas_rogue
Amai, no, mate, it's the loud one at the counter, sixty percent. All that noise is cargo with the wrong label on it.
matias_reaper
Ya, okay, we watch both, and we see. Loser buys the empanadas, cachai.

sides.tomas_warrior: nothing hangs over the camp without a safety line
sides.diego_tinker: the lantern contraption is perfectly balanced, it needs no line

third: Diego's lantern stays up, with Tomas's safety line on it, and Diego paints the line gold so it looks deliberate.
lines: tomas_warrior
Diego, there's a forty-pound lantern machine hanging over where people sleep, on one rope. Do haje, nothing goes up without a safety.
diego_tinker
My friend, my friend, it is perfectly balanced, I did the numbers twice! A safety line would ruin the whole look.
tomas_warrior
Numbers don't stop a rope fraying at three in the morning. A safety line, or it comes down, and I'm not arguing during the lift.

sides.pavlo_knight: praise a student often, and the work grows
sides.haruto_runemaster: praise rarely, so it means something when it comes

third: Haruto agrees to praise his students once a month, and Pavlo agrees to make it count.
lines: pavlo_knight
Haruto, tell your students when they do well, please, and often. A fourteen-year-old who hears it once a year stops trying.
haruto_runemaster
My master praised me once in eleven years, Pavlo, and I have remembered that sentence for thirty. Rare praise is never forgotten.
pavlo_knight
And how many of his other students stayed long enough to hear it, do you think? I would guess very few, my friend.

sides.liam_suncleric: light a backburn and let the fire meet nothing
sides.cristobal_knight: cut a firebreak and hold the line by hand

third: They cut the break together, and Liam lights a small backburn off it while Cristobal watches the wind.
lines: liam_suncleric
Mate, if that grass goes up, we backburn from the creek. Fire meets burnt ground, runs out of food, done.
cristobal_knight
Hermano, a backburn in this wind? She'll jump it and laugh at us. We cut a break by hand, wide, and we hold it.
liam_suncleric
Holding it by hand is how you lose people, and I'd rather not lose anyone today. Small backburn, off your break, deal?

sides.giorgi_primalist: the wolves taking the sheep must be driven off or killed
sides.callum_venomancer: find out why they're hungry and move them on

third: Callum tracks the pack to find what pushed it down, and Giorgi guards the flock until he's back.
lines: giorgi_primalist
Callum, the wolves took three sheep this week. A shepherd does not talk with wolves, my friend. He stands in front of the flock.
callum_venomancer
Fair enough, mate, but something's pushed them down off the high ground. Find that, and the wolves go home on their own.
giorgi_primalist
And while you are finding it, the wolves are eating. Kargi, go and look, quickly, and I will stand here being large.

sides.orlando_witchdoctor: Haruto needs a proper haircut, and soon
sides.haruto_runemaster: his hair is tied back correctly and needs nothing

third: Orlando trims it, and Haruto corrects his grip on the scissors, and both of them are pleased.
lines: orlando_witchdoctor
Haruto, mi amor, please, sit in my chair for ten minutes. That hair has been tied back the same way since the old world.
haruto_runemaster
It is tied back correctly, and it has given me no trouble for thirty years. I do not see the problem.
orlando_witchdoctor
The problem is it's beautiful hair and you're hiding it, with love. Ten minutes, and you can correct how I hold the scissors.

sides.cristobal_knight: Valparaiso is the heart of Chile, and the Wanderers are its team
sides.matias_reaper: Santiago is the real Chile, and nobody cares about the Wanderers

third: They agree Chile is the best country in two worlds, and argue about the football all night anyway.
lines: cristobal_knight
Matias, hermano, tell them the truth. Valparaiso is the soul of Chile, the hills, the port, the Wanderers, everything.
matias_reaper
Ya, the soul, okay. Santiago is the whole body, weon, and nobody in Santiago remembers the Wanderers play football.
cristobal_knight
Chucha, the disrespect! Come to the port one day and say that, and my mother will feed you until you take it back.

sides.minh_chronomancer: Liam sleeps tonight, and Minh keeps watch
sides.liam_suncleric: Minh sleeps tonight, and Liam keeps watch

third: Both of them sleep, and the youngest in camp keeps watch, under protest from both.
lines: minh_chronomancer
Liam, you have been awake for two days. I will take the watch, and you will sleep. That is the sequence.
liam_suncleric
Mate, you've got bags under your eyes I could carry shopping in. You sleep, I'll watch, I don't sleep anyway.
minh_chronomancer
That is precisely the problem with both of us, I think. Perhaps tonight neither of us is the right person for this job.

sides.giorgi_primalist: a good evening needs wine and a toast
sides.bakyt_hunter: a good evening needs tea and quiet

third: A toast with tea, which offends Giorgi slightly and pleases Bakyt enormously.
lines: giorgi_primalist
Bakyt, my friend, a table without wine is only furniture. One cup, one toast, and then your tea, I promise.
bakyt_hunter
Tea first, always tea first, friend. Wine makes young men loud and old men sleepy, and I am already old.
giorgi_primalist
Then I make the toast with tea, and the ancestors will forgive me. Gaumarjos, to stubborn old herders, both of us.

sides.orlando_witchdoctor: a party lives on music and talk
sides.sebastian_bloodmage: a party lives on the grill

third: Sebastian runs the grill, Orlando runs the room, and nobody goes home before dawn.
lines: orlando_witchdoctor
Sebastian, mi amor, a party is music and talk. Without a radio and somebody to listen, you just have people eating standing up.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, Orlando, without a grill it's a meeting, not a party! The smoke is what calls people in, ask any neighbourhood in Buenos Aires.
orlando_witchdoctor
Then you feed them and I keep them, papi, that's a deal. Your grill, my chairs, and the spirits can dance if they want.

sides.yiannis_paladin: an octopus that size belongs on the grill with lemon
sides.callum_venomancer: an octopus that clever belongs back in the water

third: Callum lets it go, and Yiannis catches a smaller, less clever one for supper.
lines: yiannis_paladin
Ela, Callum, look at this beauty, eight arms and not one of them wasted. A little lemon, a little oil, and the grill will be pleased.
callum_venomancer
Mate, it just opened a jar to get at that crab. That's one of the smartest animals in the sea, you can't eat a genius.
yiannis_paladin
In Chania we eat geniuses every Sunday, child, and we live to ninety. Clever or not, the octopus knows the sea gives and takes.

sides.rhodri_knight: build a scaffold tower up the wall, tied in properly
sides.tomas_warrior: rig a rope and pulley from the top, quicker and lighter

third: Rhodri's scaffold goes up, Tomas rigs a hoist off the top of it, and they argue about whose idea it was.
lines: rhodri_knight
Tomas, butt, a tower's what that wall wants, tied in every two metres. Tidy, solid, and nobody's dangling off a string.
tomas_warrior
Rhodri, that's a whole load-in of boards and tubes for a ten-minute lift. One line, one pulley tied off up top, and the crew's done before lunch.
rhodri_knight
Duw, and if your one rope goes, somebody's going for a swim, isn't it? Scaffold first, then you can hang your pulley off my nice tidy tower.

sides.leif_primalist: that dead tree makes good firewood, fell it
sides.bakyt_hunter: that tree marks water and shade, leave it standing

third: Leif fells the deadwood beside it instead, and Bakyt shows him the spring under the roots.
lines: leif_primalist
That one's dead standing, Bakyt. Twenty minutes with the axe and we've got wood for a week. Pretty easy call.
bakyt_hunter
Look at the grass around it, friend, greener than the rest. That tree is standing on water, and the herders use it to find the spring.
leif_primalist
Huh, didn't see that. Okay, I'll drop the one behind it, nope, the other one. You read ground better than I read timber, maybe.

sides.marcus_stormbringer: a front is coming, the pressure's dropping, make camp now
sides.minh_chronomancer: the sky is clear to the horizon, keep moving

third: They push on for an hour, and make camp just as the rain arrives, which both of them claim as being right.
lines: marcus_stormbringer
Minh, the pressure's dropping, I can feel it in my ears, and those cirrus up there mean a front within the day. Sorry, anyway, we should make camp.
minh_chronomancer
I have watched that horizon for an hour, Marcus. Clear to the edge, no traffic, nothing developing. I would continue for now.
marcus_stormbringer
Clear now, yes, that's the trap, it always looks clear before it isn't! One more hour, then, and I'll say I told you so very politely.

sides.marco_paladin: the lock is the problem, open it quietly
sides.matias_reaper: the lock is easy, the guard watching it is the problem

third: Matias keeps the guard talking about football, and Marco opens the lock while he does.
lines: marco_paladin
Allora, Matias, this lock is old work, very good work. Give me two minutes, piano, piano, and it opens without a sound.
matias_reaper
The lock is easy, Marco. The guard at the corner has looked at this door four times. He is the problem, not the lock.
marco_paladin
Va bene, you see people, I see locks. You keep him busy, ragazzo, and I will be quiet.

sides.esteban_bloodmage: operate here and now, the wound won't wait for a town
sides.liam_suncleric: stabilise, pack it, and move to somewhere safe first

third: Liam packs and stabilises, they carry the patient to cover, and Esteban operates there.
lines: esteban_bloodmage
Liam, this bleed needs a surgeon's hands now, not in an hour. I can close it here, on this ground, if you'll hold the light.
liam_suncleric
Mate, we're in the open with things still moving in the trees. Pack it, splint it, get them under cover, then you work your magic.
esteban_bloodmage
Very well, colleague, cover first, ten minutes, no more. After that the prognosis changes, and I will be operating wherever we are.

sides.ryan_warlock: read every line of the lease before signing for a shop
sides.orlando_witchdoctor: a handshake and a good feeling is enough

third: Ryan reads the lease out loud at the fire, Orlando cuts his hair while he does, and they sign together.
lines: ryan_warlock
Orlando, lad, before you take any building, give me the papers. Twenty years in Boston taught me the nice ones hide the worst clauses.
orlando_witchdoctor
Ay, Ryan, papi, the merchant shook my hand and looked me in the eye. That's the contract, in Santurce that's everything.
ryan_warlock
In Boston that's how you lose the shop and the shirt, and they'd keep the shirt. Humour me, I'll read it while you fix my hair.

sides.marco_paladin: the jars need real locking lids before something escapes
sides.callum_venomancer: a tied cloth is fine, the animals aren't trying to get out

third: Marco makes three locking lids for the worst crates, and Callum keeps cloth on the rest.
lines: marco_paladin
Callum, ragazzo, a cloth and string on a crate of death adders. Madonna, give me one evening and I make you lids that close properly.
callum_venomancer
No worries, Marco, they're happy in there, mate, adders aren't plotting anything. If they wanted out they'd have gone already.
marco_paladin
Thirty-one years, I learned one thing, everything wants out eventually. Three proper lids, for the bad ones, and I sleep better.

sides.pavlo_knight: the old road is safe, travellers have used it for centuries
sides.giorgi_primalist: the ground on that road is moving, take the high path

third: They take the high path, and Pavlo makes a note that the old road has finally changed after four hundred years.
lines: pavlo_knight
Giorgi, the old road has carried travellers through this valley for four hundred years. History is a very reliable guide, in my experience.
giorgi_primalist
History did not walk here this spring, my friend. The ground is soft and the stones are leaning. That road is going to slide.
pavlo_knight
And why do you think that is, I wonder? Very well, the high path, and I will write down that the land outvoted the history books.

sides.silas_rogue: the stranger at the fire is lying about who he is
sides.callum_venomancer: the stranger is just frightened, like any cornered animal

third: They feed the stranger and watch him, and he turns out to be both lying and terrified.
lines: silas_rogue
Callum, the stranger at the fire, sixty percent he's lying. Says he's a merchant, walks like a man who's never carried anything heavier than a secret.
callum_venomancer
Could be, mate, but look at his hands, he's shaking. That's not a liar, that's something cornered and scared out of its mind.
silas_rogue
Amai, it can be both, you know, the scared ones lie best. We feed him, and we watch him, and we'll both be right by morning.

sides.ivan_warrior: we leave at first light, which means sleeping now
sides.cristobal_knight: the village is having a fiesta tonight, and we're invited

third: One dance, Ivan's timetable, and Cristobal is asleep before Ivan is, for once.
lines: ivan_warrior
Cristobal, we leave at first light, which is five hours from now. In five hours I want everyone asleep, not dancing.
cristobal_knight
Hermano, the village invited us to their fiesta! You don't say no to a fiesta, it's rude, my mother would disown me.
ivan_warrior
Your mother is not driving this tram, my friend. One dance, then bed, and if you are late tomorrow I leave you here to dance alone.

sides.tarek_templar: the boy who stole bread was hungry, feed him and let it go
sides.adrian_templar: the rule is the same for everyone, he pays for the bread

third: The boy works an afternoon for the baker, and Tarek feeds him at the end of it.
lines: tarek_templar
Adrian, habibi, he took one loaf because he hadn't eaten in two days. Feed him, and nobody needs a ruling.
adrian_templar
If I let him off because I feel sorry for him, Tarek, the next one gets off because I like him. The rule has to be the same, properly.
tarek_templar
Then make the rule fair and kind at once, my friend. He works the afternoon for the baker, and I cook his dinner myself.

sides.emre_rogue: a door that old deserves to be opened and read
sides.owen_cultist: a sealed door in the dark is sealed for a reason

third: Emre studies the lock for an hour without opening it, and Owen keeps watch and hums.
lines: emre_rogue
Look at this door, my friends, older than the walls around it. Somebody very serious made this, Owen, and I'd like to hear what they had to say.
owen_cultist
Now then, Emre, I know a bit about things that wait in the dark. Somebody sealed it, bach, and they didn't do that for fun.
emre_rogue
Tamam, then I'll only read it, I won't open it. Even a closed door tells you who it's afraid of, and you can stand guard and hum.

sides.marco_paladin: a good safe is opened slowly, by feel, one wheel at a time
sides.emre_rogue: listen to it first, the safe tells you where it's weak

third: Marco feels the wheels while Emre listens with his ear to the door, and they open it in half the time.
lines: marco_paladin
Allora, Emre, a safe like this, you go piano, piano. One wheel, then the next, you feel it in the fingers. Thirty one years, this is how.
emre_rogue
Your fingers are very good, Marco, but you're not listening. Put your ear to it, the safe has been telling us where it's tired for five minutes.
marco_paladin
Madonna, two locksmiths and one safe, we will be here until morning. Va bene, I feel, you listen, and nobody tells the ragazzi how long it took.

sides.berat_tinker: proper Turkish tea, all day, in little glasses
sides.emre_rogue: Turkish coffee, strong, once, and done properly

third: Tea all day and one coffee after dinner, and they argue about whose grandmother made it better.
lines: berat_tinker
Emre, brother, family, it's tea, all day, little glasses, twenty of them! In Izmir nobody trusts a man who drinks coffee before noon.
emre_rogue
Twenty glasses of tea is a tea house, Berat, not a drink. One coffee, very strong, and a man can think until sunset.
berat_tinker
Tea all day, then, and your one coffee after dinner, and I'll fix the stains on your teeth for free afterwards. Open wide, you'll need it.

sides.rhodri_knight: the valleys are the heart of Wales, everybody knows it
sides.owen_cultist: the coast is where Wales breathes, Barry and the sea

third: They agree Cardiff is too posh for either of them, and sing the same hymn badly.
lines: rhodri_knight
Owen, butt, you're from Barry, isn't it? Lovely, but the valleys are the real Wales, Ponty and the rugby and the chapels on every hill.
owen_cultist
Duw, Rhodri, the valleys are lovely if you like rain sideways. Barry's got the sea, mind, and the chips, and the island in the fog.
rhodri_knight
Fair play, the chips are tidy, I'll give you that. We can both agree Cardiff's too posh for us, can't we, and sing something together.

sides.owen_cultist: three in the morning is the loneliest hour
sides.minh_chronomancer: three in the morning is the calmest hour

third: They take the late watch together, Minh calls out the stars like traffic, and Owen says it's the least lonely he's been at that hour.
lines: owen_cultist
Three in the morning, Minh, that's the loneliest hour there is. Eight years in a cab, I'd know, the whole country asleep but me.
minh_chronomancer
For me it was the calmest hour, Owen. Two aircraft on the scope, a quiet frequency, nobody shouting. I liked it very much.
owen_cultist
Then we'll take the late watch together, bach. You call out the stars like your aircraft, and I'll find out if it's lonely with company.

sides.liam_suncleric: if you go down, I'm dragging you out, promise or no promise
sides.nicolas_bloodmage: get everyone else out first, and don't drag me

third: They agree the medic who's still standing decides, and both of them know who that will be.
lines: liam_suncleric
Mate, this rule of yours, don't drag me, it's rubbish and you know it. You go down, I'm dragging you out, and you can complain about it at the barbie.
nicolas_bloodmage
Pata, you know the job. You get the others out first, then me. I've watched people die because somebody wasted a minute on the wrong patient.
liam_suncleric
Fine, here's the deal, whoever's still standing calls it. And we both know that's going to be me, so start practising your complaining.

sides.yiannis_paladin: the stream is running and cold, drink, it's fine
sides.tarek_templar: running and cold means nothing, check it first

third: Tarek checks it, it's clean, and Yiannis is unbearable about it for the rest of the day.
lines: yiannis_paladin
Ela, Tarek, look, the water is running and cold and singing over the stones. A good stream, my friend, drink, it's a gift.
tarek_templar
Running and cold tells me nothing, Yiannis. The worst spring I ever mapped was running and cold, and it made a camp sick for a week.
yiannis_paladin
Then check it, child, check it, and when it's clean I'll be very gracious. Not too gracious, I'll be a little unbearable.

sides.rhodri_knight: referees ruin the game, let the boys play
sides.adrian_templar: without a referee it isn't a game, it's a brawl

third: They mark out a rough pitch, Rhodri plays, and Adrian blows the whistle exactly twice.
lines: rhodri_knight
Adrian, butt, I've had a referee ruin every final I ever played. Let the boys sort it out on the pitch, that's proper rugby, isn't it.
adrian_templar
With respect, Rhodri, without a referee it isn't a game, it's a brawl with a ball in it. Somebody has to stay neutral when nobody else wants to be.
rhodri_knight
Duw, there's a speech, I nearly cried. Go on, then, mark out a pitch, and you can blow that whistle twice, and not one more time.

sides.adrian_templar: fall back to the ridge as planned, everyone, now
sides.nicolas_bloodmage: not without the one who's still down there

third: Adrian holds the ridge with the rest, and Nicolas goes down for the straggler with one other person, not alone.
lines: adrian_templar
Squad, the plan is the ridge, now, together. Nicolas, I know, but if we stay we lose four to save one, and I've done the sum.
nicolas_bloodmage
Then I'm the one who doesn't do the sum, Adrian. There's somebody still down there, and I don't leave people. Not for a plan, not for anything.
adrian_templar
Then you don't go alone, that's my condition. Take one more with you, and the rest of us hold the ridge until you're back, properly.

sides.tarek_templar: dig a well by the camp, it's safer and it lasts
sides.giorgi_primalist: the sheep know a good spring, follow the flock and drink there

third: They follow the animals to the spring, and Tarek sinks a well beside it so the water stays clean.
lines: tarek_templar
Giorgi, if we dig a well here by the camp, it lasts for years. Give me a few days and some stone, and nobody needs to walk for water.
giorgi_primalist
Twenty summers I follow the sheep, my friend. They find good water before any man. Follow them, and the spring is already there.
tarek_templar
Then we follow your sheep and I build at the spring they choose. Your animals do the surveying, and I do the stone, a fair split.

sides.ivan_warrior: stay on the road in line, like a tram, steady and safe
sides.nicolas_bloodmage: weave through, the gap is there, take it

third: Ivan leads the slow way with the carts, Nicolas scouts ahead through the gaps, and they meet at the far side within a minute.
lines: ivan_warrior
Nicolas, a road is a road, my friend. You stay in line, steady, like Route 13, and everybody arrives. Weaving is how passengers get hurt.
nicolas_bloodmage
Pata, nine years on a moto in Lima, if I waited in line people died in the back of taxis. The gap is there, you take it.
ivan_warrior
Fine, you weave, I drive the carts, and we see who is late. I am never late, my friend, eleven years and never.

sides.iker_guardian: push the pace, we'll be at the top by noon
sides.pasang_primalist: slowly, or half of us won't reach the top at all

third: Pasang sets the pace, and Iker runs up and down the line encouraging everybody, which tires only Iker.
lines: iker_guardian
Pasang, champion, at this speed we'll reach the top next week! Come on, double time, everybody can do it, I believe in them!
pasang_primalist
Iker, everybody can do it once, yes. Then on day four they sit down and don't get up. Bistarai, slowly, and they all arrive.
iker_guardian
Okay, okay, your pace, the mountain expert wins. But I'm allowed to cheer, that's not running, that's coaching!

sides.mateo_starcaller: travel by night, the stars are clear and I can navigate
sides.driss_shaman: travel at dawn, the ground is safer when you can see it

third: They leave two hours before dawn, Mateo navigating by the stars and Driss reading the ground as the light comes.
lines: mateo_starcaller
Driss, po, look at that sky, not a cloud, every star exactly where I mapped it. We could walk all night and never lose the road.
driss_shaman
The stars are beautiful, my friend, but the ground has holes in it, and holes don't show in starlight. In the desert we start at dawn.
mateo_starcaller
Then we split it, ya. Two hours before dawn, I steer by the stars, and you take over when you can see your holes.

sides.rhys_ranger: quiet in the woods, Tegan can't hunt with shouting
sides.iker_guardian: the team needs encouragement, loud encouragement

third: Iker coaches in sign language in the woods, badly, and Tegan catches three rabbits.
lines: rhys_ranger
Iker, please, I'm asking nicely, can you stop shouting come on in the woods? Every animal for a mile has run off, and Tegan's sulking.
iker_guardian
Rhys, champion, the team needs energy! If I stop shouting, they'll slow down, I know these people!
rhys_ranger
Then shout with your hands, cariad, wave, point, anything. Tegan will love you for it, and she doesn't love anybody.

sides.bakyt_hunter: an eagle is the true hunting bird, strong enough for a wolf
sides.rhys_ranger: a hawk is quicker and smarter, and she works with you

third: They fly both birds together at dusk, and argue for an hour about which one actually caught the hare.
lines: bakyt_hunter
Rhys, my friend, your hawk is very pretty. But my eagle takes a fox, a wolf even. That is a hunting bird, jakshy.
rhys_ranger
Your eagle's lovely, Bakyt, honest. But Tegan turns on a coin and comes back when I whistle. Yours comes back when she's finished thinking about it.
bakyt_hunter
Ha, this is true, she thinks a lot, like a grandmother. Tonight we fly both, and the hare decides who is best.

sides.cristobal_knight: straight up the gully, it's quicker, I've climbed worse
sides.pasang_primalist: the gully is where the stones come down in the afternoon

third: They take the gully at dawn, before the sun loosens the stones, and Cristobal admits it was very loud up there.
lines: cristobal_knight
Pasang, hermano, straight up that gully and we're at the top in an hour. I've climbed burning hillsides worse than that.
pasang_primalist
Burning hills don't throw rocks at you, Cristobal. That gully does, every afternoon, when the sun warms the ice. I've watched it all week.
cristobal_knight
Okay, okay, you've watched it, I've only looked at it. Dawn, then, before the rocks wake up, and I'll stop calling you slow.

sides.iker_guardian: let them play, the game needs energy, not whistles
sides.adrian_templar: without rules the game is a brawl, and somebody gets hurt

third: Adrian referees the match properly, Iker coaches both sides at once, and nobody's quite sure who won.
lines: iker_guardian
Adrian, my friend, you've blown that whistle nine times in ten minutes! Let them play, venga, the game's dying of boredom.
adrian_templar
Nine fouls, Iker, nine. If I let them play like that, somebody's going to the healer with a broken ankle, and it'll be a farmhand.
iker_guardian
Okay, you keep the whistle, I keep the shouting, and between us we'll make a real team. Spain against Spain, the referee always wins.

sides.mateo_starcaller: the sky will clear by midnight, stay up and observe
sides.marcus_stormbringer: that front isn't clearing tonight, go to sleep

third: They both stay up, the sky clears at three in the morning, and they each insist it was their forecast.
lines: mateo_starcaller
Marcus, po, those clouds are moving east, it'll be clear by midnight. Stay up with me, it's going to be a beautiful night.
marcus_stormbringer
Sorry, Mateo, but that's a slow front with a lot of moisture behind it. Clear by three at the earliest, and I'd bet on dawn.
mateo_starcaller
Then we both stay up and see who's right, ya, with tea. I'll bring the star chart, you bring your terrible weather jokes.

sides.driss_shaman: ration the water, we have three days to the next spring
sides.sebastian_bloodmage: a proper meal needs a proper pot of water

third: Sebastian grills instead of boiling, and Driss lets him have one pot for the tea.
lines: driss_shaman
Sebastian, my friend, that pot is half our water, and the next spring is three days away. Forgive me, but the pasta can wait.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, Driss, you can't feed people on rations and good manners! They need a hot meal, a big one, it's medicine.
driss_shaman
Then grill the meat, my friend, which needs no water at all, and leave me one pot for tea. Everyone eats, and everyone drinks.

sides.ryan_warlock: take the goblins' contract, the money's good, sort the details later
sides.driss_shaman: not without a proper water allowance written in

third: Ryan rewrites the contract with a water clause, Driss reads it twice, and the goblins sign it, grumbling.
lines: ryan_warlock
Driss, lads, the goblins are offering double for this run. Sign it, we'll sort the small print once we're moving.
driss_shaman
The small print is where the water lives, Ryan. I've refused two contracts over the water allowance, and both came back with a better one.
ryan_warlock
Jesus, a man after my own heart, you're right, it's always the clause they hide. Give it here, I'll write the water in myself.

sides.ivan_warrior: everybody sleeps by midnight, we leave at six
sides.mateo_starcaller: the best sky is at three in the morning, and I'll be fine

third: Mateo sleeps until two, Ivan wakes him with a tram bell, and they watch the sky together for an hour.
lines: ivan_warrior
Mateo, it's midnight, and you are still lying in the grass looking up. We leave at six, and I don't wait for passengers.
mateo_starcaller
Ivan, po, the best part of the night is at three, the dark between the moons. Half an hour, I promise, I'll be fresh as anything.
ivan_warrior
You said half an hour last night, and it was three hours. Fine, sleep now, I wake you at two, and then you look, and I look too.

sides.rhys_ranger: turn that machine off, it's terrifying the hawk
sides.diego_tinker: it's nearly working, she just needs five more minutes

third: Diego works on it inside the tent, and Tegan watches him through the flap with great suspicion.
lines: rhys_ranger
Diego, please, cariad, that machine's been clanking for an hour, and Tegan's pulling her feathers out. Turn it off, I'm begging you.
diego_tinker
Five minutes, my friend, she's nearly working, I can hear it, sure, sure! When she's done she'll be very quiet, I promise.
rhys_ranger
Then finish her inside the tent, with the flap shut. Tegan can glare at you from out here, and she will, mind.
